item.title: Opinion: Many San Diegans are just one bad break away from homelessness
item.description: Whether in their vehicles, tents in canyons, on the streets, or out on the sidewalk without shelter, many are not living ideal lives.

item.title: Wonderfront organizers still haven’t found what they’re looking for
item.description: The Wonderfront Music & Arts Festival has been playing peekaboo in downtown San Diego since it debuted in 2019 on the city’s northwestern bayfront. The multi-genre festival is currently off the map, though organizers reportedly hope to revive it before the end of 2026. Paul Thornton, the event’s organizer, told the Union-Tribune the festival was […]

item.title: Job Won: College-grad hustle, getting a boss to notice and open-office torment
item.description: Manpower executive Phil Blair has answers to some of the most common employment questions in his bi-weekly column.

item.title: San Diego teachers plan first strike in 30 years over staffing, services for special education
item.description: Teachers rallied outside a SDUSD meeting last week in anticipation of a district-wide strike at 172 campuses scheduled for Feb. 26.

item.title: San Diego and San Jose suing DOJ over withholding cyber crime funding
item.description: The lawsuit states that grants for the program are now conditional upon cities following unrelated DOJ requirements.

item.title: Mission Bay High sophomore to graduate this May
item.description: What's unusual about this is that Damian is a 16-year-old Mission Bay High sophomore who finished the requirements in two years.

item.title: Olivewood Gardens, National School District awarded for living laboratory program
item.description: A partnership between National School District and Olivewood Gardens and Learning Center has earned statewide recognition, with the district receiving a California School Boards Association Golden Bell Award in the "Climate Change Innovation" category.

item.title: ‘Ghost bike’ dedication and walk planned Tuesday for 6-year-old killed in Pacific Beach
item.description: Family and friends of 6-year-old Hudson O'Loughlin -- struck and killed by a hit-and-run driver while riding a bicycle with his family last month -- will hold a memorial walk and "ghost bike" dedication tomorrow in his honor.

item.title: SD Councilmembers pass resolution condemning ‘excessive’ ICE tactics
item.description: The San Diego City Council Monday unanimously passed a mainly symbolic resolution opposing "unnecessarily aggressive and excessive tactics" by federal agents within the Department of Homeland Security.

item.title: While Punxsutawney Phil predicts winter, San Diego County warms up
item.description: Punxsutawney Phil may be calling for six more weeks of winter, but winter is nowhere to be found in San Diego County.
